title: S46 — Morphological cleanup: open/close operations to fix broken strokes
desc: Corrosion creates gaps in strokes. Morphological closing (dilate then erode) can bridge small gaps. Implement tunable morph pipeline. Measure on corrosion family. Owner: barry. Priority: 2.

history.note: Dropped: same as S32/S33. S27 truth-mask 0/16 on corrosion means morphological ops won't help — ink is destroyed at the source.
